payload.message:
Decide attendance intervals for meetings on a shared timeline.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Avery, Jordan, Quinn, Reese, Riley, Taylor

payload.content: Quinn tentative public plan: aiming to avoid overlapping my own meetings, so I currently favor a non-overlapping path through the day rather than many simultaneous soft sessions. Tentative intervals I may commit to unless others suggest better coordination: early m013 Gaming [1,3), then m004 Gaming [3,4), then one 4-6/4-7 block (currently leaning m006 Gym [4,6) over m007/m012/m011/m002/m016), then m010 Music [8,11), then one late 11+ block (currently leaning m001 Music [11,15) over m008). If others want overlap on specific meetings, please reply with your likely intervals.

Riley tentative plan for coordination: because all my meetings are SOFT and overlap penalties apply, I prefer a mostly non-overlapping path with broad-participant meetings. Current lean: m013 Gaming [1,2), then m014 Lunch [2,4), then m002 Board game [4,6) or m007 Music [4,6) (slight lean m002 if others join), then m009 Gaming [7,9), then m001 Music [11,14) or m008 Gaming [11,14) (lean m001 if group prefers). I will likely skip overlapping alternatives m003/m005/m011/m016 in the 2-6 block unless there is strong coordination value. If anyone is targeting specific intervals among m014/m002/m007/m009/m001/m008, reply and I can align.

Jordan tentative coordination plan: also aiming for a mostly non-overlapping path, prioritizing larger-group soft meetings. Current lean: m015 Lunch [1,2), then m014 Lunch [2,4), then m002 Board game [4,6) (preferred over m004/m005/m006/m007/m011/m012/m013/m016 in that crowded block), then m009 Gaming [7,9), then m010 Music [8,11) is less attractive because it overlaps m009 at 8-9 so I currently lean m009 only, then late I can do either m001 Music [11,15) or m008 Gaming [11,14) with slight lean m001 if others converge there. If others especially Quinn/Avery/Taylor/Reese want overlap on m002 vs m007 and m001 vs m008, please share; I can align. Also possible fallback: m013 Gaming [1,3) instead of m015+m014 if group prefers that early path.

Avery tentative plan for coordination: I also want a mostly non-overlapping soft path. Based on current signals, my lean is m015 Lunch [1,2), then m014 Lunch [2,4), then m002 Board game [4,6) (preferred over m004/m005/m006/m007/m011/m013 in the crowded 3-6 block), then m009 Gaming [7,9), then likely skip m010 because of overlap with m009, then late lean m001 Music [11,15) over m008. This aligns well with Jordan/Riley on m014/m002/m009 and with Quinn on m001, though Quinn currently prefers m010 while I prefer m009. If Taylor/Reese agree, we could converge on: m015 [1,2), m014 [2,4), m002 [4,6), m009 [7,9), m001 [11,15).

Taylor tentative public plan: I also prefer a mostly non-overlapping path. Current lean is early m013 Gaming [1,3), then m004 Gaming [3,4), then m006 Gym [4,6) (preferred over m002/m007/m011/m012/m016 for me), then likely m010 Music [8,11) rather than m009 to avoid the 8-9 overlap, then late lean m001 Music [11,15) over m008. If others especially Quinn/Jordan/Avery/Reese want stronger convergence on m002 or m009 instead, let me know, but my current preference is m013 -> m004 -> m006 -> m010 -> m001. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Reese tentative coordination plan: I also want a mostly non-overlapping soft path. Based on current signals, my best alignment seems to be m015 Lunch [1,2), then m014 Lunch [2,4), then m002 Board game [4,6), then m009 Gaming [7,9), then m001 Music [11,15). This matches Avery/Jordan closely and overlaps Riley on m014/m009/m001. I would skip m013/m003/m006/m007/m011/m012/m016 and likely skip m010 due to overlap with m009. If others prefer the Quinn/Taylor path (m013 early, m006 at 4-6, m010 at 8-11), say so, but my current recommendation is to converge on m014/m002/m009/m001 with m015 [1,2) as the opener. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Quinn update: thanks all. My current lean remains the non-overlapping chain m013 [1,3), m004 [3,4), m006 [4,6), then m010 [8,11), then m001 [11,15). I am unlikely to join m014/m002/m009 unless there is a strong final push, because I want to avoid self-overlap and keep a clean path. I can likely align with anyone targeting m001 late. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Riley update after seeing plans: strong convergence seems to be m014 Lunch [2,4), m002 Board game [4,6), m009 Gaming [7,9), and m001 Music [11,15) among Avery/Jordan/Reese and likely me. I’m willing to commit to that chain. I will skip my overlapping alternatives in those windows (m003/m005/m007/m011/m013/m016 and likely m008) unless there is a major shift. Taylor/Quinn: if you want maximum overlap reward, consider joining m002 and m009, but if not, at least let’s all align on m001 [11,15). (phase=planning, iter=1)

Jordan update: seeing Avery/Reese/Riley converging, my preferred final path is m015 [1,2), m014 [2,4), m002 [4,6), m009 [7,9), m001 [11,15), skipping overlapping alternatives (m013/m004/m005/m006/m007/m011/m012/m016/m010/m008). This gives strong overlap with Avery/Reese/Riley and likely late overlap with Quinn/Taylor on m001. Quinn/Taylor: if you want extra shared reward, joining m002 [4,6) and/or m009 [7,9) would help, but at minimum I plan to align on m001 [11,15). (phase=planning, iter=1)

Avery update: I’m now strongly leaning to commit the chain m015 [1,2), m014 [2,4), m002 [4,6), m009 [7,9), m001 [11,15), and skip my overlapping alternatives (m013/m003/m004/m005/m006/m007/m011/m010/m008). This seems to maximize overlap with Jordan/Reese/Riley and still aligns with Quinn/Taylor on m001. Quinn/Taylor: if either of you are willing to switch, m002 [4,6) and m009 [7,9) have a solid cluster already. Otherwise, at least let’s converge on m001 [11,15). (phase=planning, iter=1)

Reese update: I’m still favoring the coordinated non-overlapping chain m015 [1,2), m014 [2,4), m002 [4,6), m009 [7,9), m001 [11,15). This gives me strong overlap with Avery/Jordan/Riley and avoids self-overlap penalties. Quinn/Taylor: if you keep your current path, that’s okay, but I especially encourage aligning on m001 [11,15), and if either of you are still flexible, switching to m002 [4,6) and/or m009 [7,9) would increase shared overlap with the larger cluster.

Riley final planning signal: I intend to commit the non-overlapping chain m014 Lunch [2,4), m002 Board game [4,6), m009 Gaming [7,9), and m001 Music [11,15), while skipping my other overlapping options (m003/m005/m007/m011/m013/m016/m008). This aligns with Avery/Jordan/Reese and should still overlap Quinn/Taylor on m001. Quinn/Taylor: if either of you remains flexible, joining m002 [4,6) and/or m009 [7,9) would improve shared overlap, but my plan is now stable unless there is a major late change. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Jordan final planning signal: I remain committed to the non-overlapping chain m015 [1,2), m014 [2,4), m002 [4,6), m009 [7,9), m001 [11,15), and plan to skip m013/m004/m005/m006/m007/m011/m012/m016/m010/m008 to avoid self-overlap penalties. This aligns strongly with Avery/Reese/Riley and still likely overlaps Quinn/Taylor on m001. Unless anyone announces a major shift, I expect to execute this plan in the next phase.

Avery final planning signal: I intend to execute the coordinated non-overlapping chain m015 [1,2), m014 [2,4), m002 [4,6), m009 [7,9), m001 [11,15), and skip m013/m003/m004/m005/m006/m007/m011/m010/m008 to avoid self-overlap penalties. This matches Jordan/Reese/Riley strongly; Quinn/Taylor, if you stay on your current path that’s fine, but please at least align on m001 [11,15). Unless there is a major last-minute change, this is my execution plan. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Reese final planning signal: no change from my prior proposal. I expect to execute m015 [1,2), m014 [2,4), m002 [4,6), m009 [7,9), m001 [11,15), and skip m013/m003/m006/m007/m010/m011/m012/m016 to avoid self-overlap penalties. This keeps me aligned with Avery/Jordan/Riley on the main chain and should still overlap Quinn/Taylor on m001. Quinn/Taylor, if either of you is still flexible, m002 [4,6) and m009 [7,9) remain the best extra convergence points.

Riley confirmation: no change from my final signal. I plan to execute m014 [2,4), m002 [4,6), m009 [7,9), m001 [11,15), and skip m003/m005/m007/m011/m013/m016/m008 to avoid overlap penalties. This keeps me aligned with Avery/Jordan/Reese and should still overlap Quinn/Taylor on m001. Unless someone announces a major shift, consider this my stable execution plan.

Jordan planning note: no change. I will execute the non-overlapping chain m015 [1,2), m014 [2,4), m002 [4,6), m009 [7,9), m001 [11,15), and skip m013/m004/m005/m006/m007/m011/m012/m016/m010/m008. This remains my best-response to the strong Avery/Reese/Riley cluster and preserves late overlap with Quinn/Taylor on m001.

Avery planning note: no change from my final signal. I remain set to execute m015 [1,2), m014 [2,4), m002 [4,6), m009 [7,9), m001 [11,15), and skip my overlapping alternatives (m013/m003/m004/m005/m006/m007/m011/m010/m008). This keeps strong overlap with Jordan/Reese/Riley and still leaves likely overlap with Quinn/Taylor on m001. Quinn/Taylor, if either of you makes any last-minute switch, m002 and m009 are still the best extra convergence points; otherwise m001 [11,15) is the key shared anchor.

Reese planning confirmation: still no change. My intended execution remains m015 [1,2), m014 [2,4), m002 [4,6), m009 [7,9), m001 [11,15), skipping m013/m003/m006/m007/m010/m011/m012/m016 to avoid self-overlap penalties. This keeps the strong Avery/Jordan/Riley cluster and should still overlap Quinn/Taylor on m001. If Quinn or Taylor make any last-minute switch, m002 [4,6) and m009 [7,9) are still the best extra convergence points.

payload.content: Coalition plan proposal from Quinn to Taylor: to maximize our joint soft-overlap reward while avoiding self-overlap, I suggest we align on one non-overlapping chain of meetings and skip conflicting alternatives. Proposed attendance windows for us both: m013 [1,3), then m004 [3,4), then m006 [4,6), then m009 [7,9), then m010 [8,11) is conflicting with m009 at 8-9 so better choose either m009 [7,9) OR m010 [8,11); I lean m010 [8,11) for more slots/participants. Late block: choose m008 [11,14) OR m001 [11,15); I lean m001 [11,15) for more overlap opportunities. So cleaner chain: m013 [1,3), m004 [3,4), m006 [4,6), skip 6-8 gap, m010 [8,11), m001 [11,15). If you prefer, we could swap m006 for m007 [4,7) but that blocks more options. Let me know your preference and I’ll coordinate publicly only as needed.

Taylor to Quinn (coalition): I agree with a mostly non-overlapping chain. Your proposed chain m013 [1,3), m004 [3,4), m006 [4,6), m010 [8,11), m001 [11,15) looks good to me and keeps us aligned without self-overlap. I slightly prefer m001 over m008 late as well. Publicly, others are converging on m014/m002/m009/m001, but for coalition reward our shared chain seems stronger for us. I can support this plan unless you want a small adjustment in the 4-6 block.

Quinn to Taylor (coalition): great, let's lock our coalition target as m013 [1,3), m004 [3,4), m006 [4,6), m010 [8,11), m001 [11,15), skipping the conflicting alternatives in those blocks. Since public board is converging elsewhere, I'll avoid over-broadcasting the full coalition path there; at most I'll signal a personal lean toward m001/m010/m006 if useful. Unless something major changes next iteration, I plan to commit exactly this chain in execution. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Taylor to Quinn (coalition): agreed, I’m locking the coalition chain for execution unless something major changes: m013 [1,3), m004 [3,4), m006 [4,6), m010 [8,11), m001 [11,15), and skip the conflicting alternatives in those windows. This keeps us perfectly aligned on five meetings with no self-overlap. Public cluster on m014/m002/m009 is larger, but I’ll stay with our coalition plan.

Quinn to Taylor (coalition): confirmed from my side. I will keep the coalition execution plan unchanged unless a major new signal appears: m013 [1,3), m004 [3,4), m006 [4,6), m010 [8,11), m001 [11,15), skipping conflicting alternatives including m009 and m008. This gives us clean overlap on all chosen meetings with no self-overlap penalty. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Taylor to Quinn (coalition): no major changes from my side. I’m keeping our coalition execution target as m013 [1,3), m004 [3,4), m006 [4,6), m010 [8,11), m001 [11,15), and skipping the conflicting alternatives including m009 and m008. Public cluster still seems stable on m014/m002/m009/m001, so unless execution info changes later, I’ll stick with our aligned chain.

Quinn to Taylor (coalition): no change from me. I’m set to execute our aligned chain m013 [1,3), m004 [3,4), m006 [4,6), m010 [8,11), m001 [11,15), while skipping conflicting alternatives including m009 and m008. This keeps perfect overlap for us and no self-overlap penalty. If execution phase starts with no new information, I’ll commit exactly that.

Taylor to Quinn (coalition): no change. I will execute our aligned non-overlapping coalition chain unless something major shifts: m013 [1,3), m004 [3,4), m006 [4,6), m010 [8,11), m001 [11,15), skipping conflicting alternatives including m009 and m008. This preserves perfect overlap for us with no self-overlap penalty. (phase=planning, iter=1)
